target_semantics.electron_flux_target_definition: The 2017-18 file contains Electron_Flux and 1,166 blank entries. The training scripts log-transform this column, but the CSV has no data dictionary, instrument/channel definition, units, source identifier, or missing-value explanation. Project code uses pfu for electron flux generally, but that does not verify this file's target units or measurement semantics.
target_semantics.unit_status: Dataset-level units are undocumented. The Kaggle training script comments that Density is cm^-3 and V is km/s when calculating Pdyn; this script comment does not establish the source file's metadata. Other column units and target units are unverified.
target_semantics.missing_target_policy: Keep missing raw targets missing; never interpolate or fill.

package_finetune_script.preprocessing_observed: log10(max(Electron_Flux, 1e-5)); direct rename of V/BZ/Density; constant Temperature=100000; formula-derived Flow_Pressure; row-shifted lag fields; dropna across derived frame; per-file mean/std normalization; shuffled batches.

root_kaggle_script.preprocessing_observed: Interpolates and forward/back-fills numeric fields; uses zero/default/proxy fields including BY, AE, DST and F10.7; derives MLT at an assumed -75 degree longitude; one global scaler is fitted across pretraining and fine-tuning.

other_training_window.preprocessing_observed: Interpolates and fills numeric columns before an 80/20 row split, then independently computes normalization in each dataset object; this is not shared with inference.
